title: Restructure on-prem licensing model and support tier matrix for Private/VPC
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Problem statement: enterprise prospects evaluating Private/VPC and on-prem packages ask for clearer commercial options and security commitments. Current quotes are ad-hoc (seat + infra markup) and drive long procurement cycles and support confusion. Goal: propose a standardized commercial framework (license fee, optional capacity commitments, and a support tier matrix) that shortens procurement, aligns ARR vs one-time revenue, and maps to security questionnaire answers and upgrade cadence obligations.

Scope: define three licensing paths (annual perpetual-style license with maintenance, annual subscription with capacity commits, and reserved-capacity subscription) with clear list prices and negotiation bands; design support tiers (Standard, Enterprise, Premium) with SLAs, included runbooks / onboarding hours, and escalation windows; document upgrade and patch cadence (security-only vs feature minor vs major upgrades), EOL policy and compatible window for backports; create canonical language for security questionnaires (answers, evidence locations) and an attachment checklist for RFPs.

Constraints & trade-offs considered: prefer ARR-aligned subscription to reduce on-prem churn but keep a perpetual option for regulated customers; balancing pricing simplicity (few SKUs) vs sales flexibility (discount bands); we must avoid promising continuous major feature upgrades in lower tiers to limit engineering churn. This ticket covers PM decisions, commercial materials, security Qs mapping, and an initial pilot with 3 existing prospects to validate uplift and objections.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized price table with public list price and negotiation bands
Support tier matrix published to sales playbook and Confluence
Security questionnaire canonical answers filed and evidence links recorded
Pilot completed with 3 prospects and learnings documented
decisions: Adopt three licensing paths: Perpetual+Maintenance, Subscription with commits, Reserved Capacity subscription
Support tiers will be Standard (48h response), Enterprise (4h response), Premium (1h response with dedicated TAM option)
Upgrade cadence: Monthly security patches, Quarterly minor feature releases, Annual major releases; backports supported for Enterprise and Premium for 12 months
